supporting_observations.claim: The periodic connections align with the approved GradeBook Pro updater behavior: the updater is configured to check update.gradebookpro.com about every five minutes.
The GradeBook Pro updater process was created under raul.diaz’s account, and its recorded network connections went to the organization’s proxy on port 8080.

The proxy records identify update.gradebookpro.com as the CONNECT destination for the observed checks. The successful tunnels and the 403 denial and 504 gateway error occurred within the same recurring sequence.
The updater process exited shortly after the final observed check, consistent with a bounded updater run during the alerted period.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy CONNECT records and network metadata establish the requested destination and tunnel status, but do not reveal the HTTPS content.
The supplied records do not include a file hash or signature verification for the GradeBook Pro updater executable.
The supplied records are limited to the stated review window and available telemetry; they do not establish what may have occurred outside it.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish the contents or integrity of data exchanged inside the HTTPS tunnels.
The evidence does not independently verify that the updater executable on disk is authentic.
unrelated_findings: A UserAssist registry value appears to encode a launch path for mstsc.exe on WS-RDIAZ-01. Since the stated practice limits remote administration to WS-SBYRNE-01, review this separately; this record alone does not establish a remote session or malicious activity. (T296-00034)
